Adapted from https://github.com/huggingface/diffusers (Apache-2.0, see LICENSE in this
directory) -- CogVideoX pipeline (pipelines/cogvideo/pipeline_cogvideox.py) -- with the
test-time guidance mechanism following https://github.com/agwmon/frame-guidance.
Modifications: the denoising loop exposes intermediate frames to a differentiable GeCo
consistency loss (VGGT + UFM) whose gradient steers selected frames during sampling.
